value.name: Lucia reveals she kept the letter
value.description: Lucia explains that she found the letter, has reread it every night, and hesitated to give it to Daniel because she did not know whether it was evidence or just a letter.
evidence: "I read it the night I found it and I have read it again every night since and I did not know whether to give it to you because I did not know whether you would think it was evidence of something or just — a letter."

value.name: Daniel reacts with alarm
value.description: Daniel addresses Lucia by name and his voice becomes very thin, signaling distress at her revelation.
evidence: "Lucia," Daniel said. His voice had gone very thin.

value.name: Lucia apologizes for withholding the letter
value.description: Lucia apologizes repeatedly and admits she has not known what to do about the letter.
evidence: "I'm sorry. I'm sorry, Daniel. I have not known what to do."

value.name: Daniel confronts Lucia about the delay
value.description: Daniel points out that Lucia has had the letter for nearly a week and never told him or anyone else.
evidence: "You have had it for a *week.*"
"I have had it for six days."
"And you didn't tell me."
"No."
"You didn't tell *anyone*."
"I'm telling someone now."

value.name: Asha notices Daniel's wedding ring
value.description: Asha observes Daniel gripping and releasing the newel post and notices his wedding ring, prompting thoughts about his unseen wife and the week's events in the house.
evidence: "Asha watched Daniel's hand tighten on the newel post and then loosen."

"He had a wedding ring on, she noticed, and the ring caught the light when his hand moved, and she thought briefly and irrelevantly about the wife she had not yet met and wondered what that woman knew about what was happening in this house this week."

value.name: Asha sends Lucia to retrieve the letter
value.description: Asha instructs Lucia to go upstairs and get the letter, and Lucia complies.
evidence: "Ms. Serrano," she said. "Would you go and get the letter, please."
"Lucia nodded and went up the stairs."

value.name: Daniel remains tense as Lucia leaves
value.description: Daniel watches Lucia go upstairs without moving from the newel post, while Rosa stands silently by the dining room door observing the moment.
evidence: "Daniel watched her go and did not move from the newel post."

"Rosa stood very still by the door to the dining room, with her arms folded across her cardigan, and her face had taken on the expression of a person who has been waiting a long time for a thing she was not entirely sure would happen, and was now watching it happen."

value.name: Daniel asks for a private word
value.description: While Lucia is still on the stairs, Daniel quietly asks Asha for a word, indicating he wants to speak before the letter is produced.
evidence: "Counselor," Daniel said quietly, while Lucia was still on the stairs. "A word."

value.name: Asha refuses Daniel's request
value.description: Asha insists that any private conversation must wait until after they see the letter, and Daniel silently challenges her with a look.
evidence: "After we see the letter."
"Before."
"After."
"He looked at her. She looked back."
